name: countries-map-dev
description: Builder and demo runner for countries-map
author: Jago MF <jago@lunadevel.com>

scripts.demo: npm run minify && ng build countries-map && ng serve
scripts.build:demo: npm run minify && ng build countries-map && ng build countries-map-dev
scripts.build:prod: npm run minify && ng build countries-map --configuration production && npm run dist:copy
scripts.dist:publish: npm run dist && cd dist/countries-map && npm publish
scripts.dist:copy: cp ./README.md dist/countries-map/ && cp ./CHANGELOG.md dist/countries-map/ && cp LICENSE dist/countries-map/
